scope: Pure N2 pressure relaxation of two well-mixed rigid finite reservoirs connected by an isothermal rigid pore column. Reservoir and pore inventories evolve together. Full pore storage is retained; no quasi-steady blowdown formula, thermal evolution, reaction, or real-brick qualification.
entropy_definition: Relative ideal-gas entropy -R*n*ln(c/c_ref) at one common fixed T, including both finite reservoirs and pore cells. All local control volumes obey Udot = incoming minus outgoing stream h plus bath Q; h=u+RT and Q=-RT*ndot. Closed total inventory makes net bath heat and bath entropy zero; internal face entropy production equals total gas entropy increase.
physical_input_classification: Declared straight capillary bundle and well-mixed vessel geometry. Initial pore pressure is the cell average of the linear interpolation between initial vessel pressures, hence compatible with the initial boundary values. Source-qualified approximate N2 viscosity and Knudsen law. u=1000 J/mol is an arbitrary common energy gauge at this fixed T, not a heat capacity or formation energy.
source_basis: SAND2012-5961 equation1 pore storage, equation23 pure gas Darcy-Knudsen flux, section3.2 finite vessels
Finite-volume mass conservation with ideal rigid well-mixed reservoirs; source section3.2 quasi-steady pore-storage neglect is NOT used here.
